description: Retrieves components published in a specific Figma team's library; the team must have published components, otherwise an empty list is returned.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for `GetTeamComponents` action. Defines the parameters to fetch a paginated list of components from a specific team's library.

after.description: Opaque cursor indicating the point after which to retrieve components. Used for pagination. Exclusive with the `before` parameter. The cursor value is an internally tracked integer that doesn't correspond to any specific Figma IDs.
after.title: After

before.description: Opaque cursor indicating the point before which to retrieve components. Used for pagination. Exclusive with the `after` parameter. The cursor value is an internally tracked integer that doesn't correspond to any specific Figma IDs.
before.title: Before

page_size.description: Number of components to return per page. Maximum value is 1000.
page_size.title: Page Size

team_id.description: The unique identifier of the Figma team from which to retrieve published components. IMPORTANT: Team IDs cannot be obtained programmatically via the Figma API. To find your team_id: navigate to your team page in the Figma web app (https://www.figma.com/files/team/YOUR_TEAM_ID/Team-Name), the team_id is the numeric string after '/team/' in the URL.
team_id.title: Team Id

inputSchema.title: GetTeamComponentsRequest

name: get_team_components

containing_frame.description: Details about the frame in which the component is located within the library, if applicable.
containing_frame.title: Containing Frame

created_at.description: The timestamp (UTC ISO 8601 format) indicating when the component was created.
created_at.title: Created At

description.description: A description of the component, typically provided by its publisher.
description.title: Description

file_key.description: The unique identifier of the Figma file where this component is defined.
file_key.title: File Key

key.description: The unique, globally identifiable key for the component.
key.title: Key

name.description: The name of the component as it appears in Figma.
name.title: Name

node_id.description: The unique identifier of the component node within its Figma file.
node_id.title: Node Id

thumbnail_url.description: URL for a thumbnail image preview of the component. May not always be present.
thumbnail_url.title: Thumbnail Url

updated_at.description: The timestamp (UTC ISO 8601 format) indicating when the component was last updated.
updated_at.title: Updated At

user.description: Information about the Figma user who created or last updated the component.
user.title: User

name.description: The name assigned to the component set node.
name.title: Name

nodeId.description: The unique identifier of the component set node.
nodeId.title: Node Id

backgroundColor.description: The background color of the frame node, if set.
backgroundColor.title: Background Color

containingComponentSet.description: Details of the component set that contains this frame node, if applicable.
containingComponentSet.title: Containing Component Set

containingStateGroup.description: Deprecated. Use `containingComponentSet` for more accurate component structure information.
containingStateGroup.title: Containing State Group

name.description: The name of the frame node.
name.title: Name

nodeId.description: The unique identifier of the frame node within the Figma file.
nodeId.title: Node Id

pageId.description: The unique identifier of the page that contains this frame node.
pageId.title: Page Id

pageName.description: The name of the page that contains this frame node.
pageName.title: Page Name

name.description: The name assigned to the state group node.
name.title: Name

nodeId.description: The unique identifier of the state group node.
nodeId.title: Node Id

data.description: The main data payload of the response, including status, error indicator, and the retrieved components along with pagination cursors.
data.title: Data

GetTeamComponentsResponse.title: GetTeamComponentsResponse

cursor.description: Contains opaque cursors for pagination, allowing navigation to the next or previous set of components.
cursor.title: Cursor

error.description: Indicates if an error occurred. For successful requests, this value is `false`.
error.title: Error

status.description: HTTP status code of the response. A value of 200 indicates success.

handle.description: The user's Figma display name or handle.
